title.zh: 卷246 列傳三十三 谭泰 何洛会 锡图库 博尔辉 冷僧机
title.en: Volume 246 Biographies 33: Tan Tai, He Luohui, Xi Tu Ku, Bo Er Hui, Leng Sengji
title.raw: 卷246 列傳三十三 谭泰 何洛会 锡图库 博尔辉 冷僧机

sentences.zh: =譚泰=譚泰，舒穆祿氏，滿洲正黃旗人，揚古利從弟也。

translations.literal: Tan Tai, of the Sumuru clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and a younger cousin of Yangguli.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai of the Sumuru clan was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and a younger cousin of Yangguli.

sentences.zh: 初授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: At first he was appointed niru ejen (company commander).
translations.idiomatic: He was first appointed company commander (niru ejen).

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，擢巴牙喇章京，與固山額真圖爾格分統左右翼兵，略錦州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong he was promoted to bayara janggin; together with gushan ejen Turgai he commanded the left and right wing troops in a raid on Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tiancong (1634) he was promoted to bayara janggin and, with gushan ejen Turgai, led the left and right wings in a foray against Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 還從太宗伐明，自上方堡毀邊牆以入，敗明兵，克保安州。

translations.literal: On returning he followed Taizong in a campaign against Ming; they entered through Shangfang Fort by breaching the border wall, defeated Ming troops, and captured Bao'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march he followed Taizong against the Ming, entered through Shangfang Fort by breaking the border wall, routed Ming forces, and took Bao'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 擢巴牙喇纛章京，令關白諸事。

translations.literal: He was promoted to bayara dafan janggin and ordered to report on all matters.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to chief bayara janggin and charged with reporting on affairs.

sentences.zh: 九年，揚古利賜第，侍衛宗室濟馬護欲得其舊居，揚古利不可。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Yangguli was granted a residence; the guardsman of the imperial clan Jimaohu wished to obtain his former dwelling, but Yangguli refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Yangguli received a granted residence; the guardsman of the imperial clan Jimaohu wanted his old quarters, but Yangguli would not yield them.

sentences.zh: 濟馬護囑譚泰入奏，譚泰匿不以聞，濟馬護訴於上，上責譚泰曰：「爾為朕耳目，凡事當無隱。

translations.literal: Jimaohu asked Tan Tai to memorialize the throne; Tan Tai concealed the matter and did not report it. Jimaohu appealed to the emperor, who reproached Tan Tai, saying: "You are my eyes and ears; in all matters there must be nothing hidden.
translations.idiomatic: Jimaohu asked Tan Tai to present the matter to the throne, but Tan Tai kept it secret. When Jimaohu appealed to the emperor, the emperor rebuked Tan Tai: "You are my eyes and ears; nothing should be concealed from me.

sentences.zh: 濟馬護乃朕叔父之子，其言尚不能達，民間勞苦嗟怨，何由得使朕知？

translations.literal: Jimaohu is the son of my uncle; even his words cannot reach me—how then can the people's toil and complaints of hardship reach me?
translations.idiomatic: Jimaohu is my uncle's son; if even his words cannot reach me, how can the people's hardships and grievances ever come to my knowledge?

sentences.zh: 爾恃宗族強盛，欺陵愚弱，朕所深惡！

translations.literal: You rely on the strength of your clan to bully the foolish and weak—this is what I deeply detest!
translations.idiomatic: You rely on your clan's power to bully the weak—this I deeply abhor!

sentences.zh: 」下刑部質訊，奪官。

translations.literal: " He was sent to the Board of Punishments for examination and stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: " He was referred to the Board of Punishments for investigation and deprived of his post.

sentences.zh: 尋复授本旗固山額真。

translations.literal: Before long he was again appointed gushan ejen of his own banner.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was reappointed gushan ejen of his banner.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從武英郡王阿濟格等伐明，克延慶等十二城。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed Prince Wuying Ajige and others in a campaign against Ming and captured twelve cities including Yanqing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde (1636) he followed Prince Wuying Ajige and others against the Ming and captured twelve cities including Yanqing.

sentences.zh: 進圍定興，先登有功。

translations.literal: Advancing to besiege Dingxing, he was first over the wall and had merit.
translations.idiomatic: When the army advanced to besiege Dingxing he was first over the wall and distinguished himself.

sentences.zh: 復與固山額真阿山等設伏，敗明遵化三屯營守兵，盡殲之。

translations.literal: Again, with gushan ejen Ashan and others he laid an ambush and defeated the Ming garrison of Zunhua's Santunying, annihilating them completely.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined gushan ejen Ashan and others in an ambush that routed and wiped out the Ming garrison at Zunhua's Santunying.

sentences.zh: 師還，宴勞。

translations.literal: When the army returned, a feast was held in his honor.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return a feast was held in his honor.

sentences.zh: 復從上伐朝鮮，朝鮮王棄城走，譚泰率師入其城，盡收其輜重。

translations.literal: Again he followed the emperor in a campaign against Korea; the Korean king abandoned the city and fled. Tan Tai led troops into the city and seized all its baggage and stores.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed the emperor against Korea; when the Korean king abandoned his capital and fled, Tan Tai led troops into the city and seized all its baggage and supplies.

sentences.zh: 從上逐朝鮮王至南漢城，受降而還。

translations.literal: He followed the emperor in pursuing the Korean king to Namhansŏng and accepted his surrender before returning.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued the Korean king with the emperor to Namhansŏng, accepted his surrender, and returned.

sentences.zh: 四年，從睿親王多爾袞等伐明，與固山額真葉臣自太平寨破青山口，與明兵十三戰，皆捷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed Prince Regent Dorgon and others in a campaign against Ming; with gushan ejen Yechen he broke through Qingshankou from Taipingzhai and fought thirteen battles with Ming troops, all victorious.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he followed Prince Regent Dorgon and others against the Ming; with gushan ejen Yechen he broke through Qingshankou from Taipingzhai and fought thirteen engagements with Ming forces, winning every one.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍鞏阿岱，濟馬護兄也，譚泰與相詬於禁門，坐罰。

translations.literal: Assistant State Prince Gongadai, elder brother of Jimaohu, exchanged insults with Tan Tai at the Forbidden Gate; both were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant State Prince Gongadai, Jimaohu's elder brother, traded insults with Tan Tai at the palace gate; both were penalized.

sentences.zh: 六年，從圍錦州，譚泰將四百人自小凌河直抵海濱，絕明兵歸路。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, during the siege of Jinzhou, Tan Tai led four hundred men from the Xiao Ling River straight to the seashore, cutting off the Ming army's line of retreat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, during the siege of Jinzhou, Tan Tai led four hundred men from the Xiao Ling River to the coast, severing the Ming army's escape route.

sentences.zh: 與明總督洪承疇兵戰，大敗之。

translations.literal: He fought the troops of Ming Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou and routed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: He engaged the forces of Ming Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou and inflicted a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 授世職二等參將。

translations.literal: He was granted a hereditary rank of second-class deputy general.
translations.idiomatic: He received a hereditary office as second-class deputy general.

sentences.zh: 七年，從輔國公篇古等攻薊州，擊敗明總兵白騰蛟、白廣恩等，俘馘為諸軍最。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Assistant State Prince Piangu and others in an attack on Jizhou, defeating Ming Commander-in-Chief Bai Tengjiao, Bai Guang'en, and others; captives and heads taken exceeded those of any other unit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he followed Assistant State Prince Piangu and others against Jizhou, routed Ming commanders Bai Tengjiao and Bai Guang'en, and took more prisoners and heads than any other force.

sentences.zh: 八年，命率銳卒與固山額真準塔更番戍錦州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was ordered to lead picked troops with gushan ejen Zuntai to rotate in garrison at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was ordered to lead elite troops with gushan ejen Zuntai in rotating garrison duty at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，逐破李自成於慶都。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the entry into the Pass and pursued and broke Li Zicheng at Qingdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi (1644) he followed the army through the Pass and pursued Li Zicheng, defeating him at Qingdu.

sentences.zh: 復將巴牙喇兵躡擊，至真定，大破之，敘功授一等公。

translations.literal: Again he led bayara troops in pursuit; reaching Zhending he inflicted a great defeat, and for his merit was granted the rank of first-class duke.
translations.idiomatic: He again led bayara troops in pursuit; at Zhending he won a great victory and was rewarded with the rank of first-class duke.

sentences.zh: 睿親王攝政，譚泰與巴牙喇纛章京圖賴、啟心郎索尼並見信任。

translations.literal: When Prince Regent Dorgon held the regency, Tan Tai, together with bayara dafan janggin Tualai and kixinlang Sony, all enjoyed his trust.
translations.idiomatic: Under Prince Regent Dorgon's regency, Tan Tai shared the regent's confidence with bayara dafan janggin Tualai and kixinlang Sony.

sentences.zh: 固山額真何洛會誣肅親王豪格怨譚泰等不附己，訐之睿親王，王謂譚泰忠，益信任之。

translations.literal: Gushan ejen He Luohui falsely accused Prince Su Hooge of resenting Tan Tai and others for not siding with him and denounced him to the Prince Regent; the prince said Tan Tai was loyal and trusted him all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Gushan ejen He Luohui falsely charged Prince Su Hooge with resenting Tan Tai and others for refusing to follow him and reported this to the Prince Regent; the prince declared Tan Tai loyal and trusted him still more.

sentences.zh: 大學士希福忤譚泰，希福欲易賜第，譚泰不可，希福誚之，益怒。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Hifu offended Tan Tai; Hifu wished to exchange his granted residence, but Tan Tai refused, and Hifu mocked him, increasing Tan Tai's anger.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Hifu crossed Tan Tai; when Hifu sought to exchange his granted residence Tan Tai refused, and Hifu's mockery only deepened Tan Tai's wrath.

sentences.zh: 其弟譚布以希福述睿親王自言過誤告譚泰，譚泰訐之法司，希福坐黜。

translations.literal: His younger brother Tan Bu told Tan Tai that Hifu had repeated the Prince Regent's own admissions of error; Tan Tai denounced this to the legal authorities, and Hifu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Tan Bu reported that Hifu had repeated the Prince Regent's self-criticisms; Tan Tai denounced him to the courts and Hifu was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 二年，英親王阿濟格坐奏軍事不實得罪，命譚泰與鰲拜等集眾宣其罪。

translations.literal: In the second year Prince Ying Ajige was punished for reporting military affairs untruthfully; Tan Tai was ordered with Oboi and others to assemble the masses and proclaim his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Prince Ying Ajige was punished for false military reports; Tan Tai was ordered with Oboi and others to gather the troops and announce Ajige's offenses.

sentences.zh: 譚泰匿諭旨不以示眾，索尼發其罪，降世職昂邦章京，奪官。

translations.literal: Tan Tai concealed the imperial edict and did not show it to the assembly; Sony exposed his offense, and he was reduced to hereditary ambad janggin and stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai hid the edict and did not display it to the crowd; Sony exposed the offense, and Tan Tai was reduced to hereditary ambad janggin and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 譚泰怨索尼，訐索尼於內庫牧馬鼓琴及禁門橋下捕魚，索尼亦坐黜。

translations.literal: Tan Tai resented Sony and denounced him for playing the zither while tending horses in the inner treasury and fishing under the palace bridge; Sony was also dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai bore a grudge against Sony and accused him of playing the zither while tending horses in the inner treasury and fishing beneath the palace bridge; Sony too was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 譚泰復起為本旗固山額真。

translations.literal: Tan Tai was again raised up as gushan ejen of his own banner.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai was restored as gushan ejen of his banner.

sentences.zh: 初，師下江南，譚泰自西安逐捕流寇，慮不與平江南功，使謂圖賴曰：「我軍道迂險，後至。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the army descended on Jiangnan, Tan Tai pursued bandits from Xi'an and feared he would miss credit for pacifying Jiangnan; he sent word to Tualai, saying: "Our route is long and perilous; we arrive late.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, as the army moved south, Tan Tai hunted rebels from Xi'an and feared missing credit for pacifying Jiangnan; he sent word to Tualai: "Our march is long and difficult; we arrive late.

sentences.zh: 今南京未下，請留待我軍。

translations.literal: Nanjing is not yet taken—please wait for our army."
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing is not yet taken—please wait for our troops."

sentences.zh: 」圖賴書告索尼，使啟睿親王，或發觀之，懼譚泰得罪，毀其書勿使達索尼。

translations.literal: Tualai wrote to inform Sony and have him report to the Prince Regent; fearing Tan Tai would be punished, he destroyed the letter and did not let it reach Sony.
translations.idiomatic: Tualai wrote Sony to alert the Prince Regent; fearing Tan Tai would be punished, someone destroyed the letter so it never reached Sony.

sentences.zh: 圖賴師還，詰索尼，發其事，王鞫齎書者，得狀。

translations.literal: When Tualai's army returned he questioned Sony, and the affair came to light; the prince interrogated the bearer of the letter and obtained the facts.
translations.idiomatic: When Tualai's army returned he confronted Sony, the matter was exposed, and the prince examined the letter-bearer and established the facts.

sentences.zh: 譚泰又坐與婦翁固山額真阿山遣巫者治病。

translations.literal: Tan Tai was again punished for having a shaman treat illness at the instance of his father-in-law, gushan ejen Ashan.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai was again implicated because he and his father-in-law, gushan ejen Ashan, had employed a shaman to treat illness.

sentences.zh: 下廷臣議罪，論死，下獄，王使視之，並餽食焉。

translations.literal: The court ministers were ordered to deliberate his punishment; death was proposed and he was imprisoned; the prince sent men to see him and even provided food.
translations.idiomatic: Court ministers were convened to fix his penalty; death was recommended and he was imprisoned; the prince sent men to visit him and even supplied food.

sentences.zh: 譚泰曰：「王若拯我，我殺身報王！

translations.literal: Tan Tai said: "If Your Highness saves me, I will repay you with my life!"
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai said: "If Your Highness rescues me, I will repay you with my life!"

sentences.zh: 」乃出之獄。

translations.literal: " He was then released from prison.
translations.idiomatic: " He was then released from prison.

sentences.zh: 五年，復原官。

translations.literal: In the fifth year his former office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year his former rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 金聲桓叛江西，授譚泰征南大將軍，率師討之。

translations.literal: When Jin Shengzhuan rebelled in Jiangxi, Tan Tai was appointed Grand General for the Southern Expedition and led an army against him.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin Shengzhuan rebelled in Jiangxi, Tan Tai was made Grand General for the Southern Expedition and led troops to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 聲桓以步騎七萬人抗我師，譚泰督諸軍與戰，次九江，大敗聲桓兵，獲其舟以濟師。

translations.literal: Shengzhuan opposed our army with seventy thousand infantry and cavalry; Tan Tai directed the forces in battle; at Jiujiang he routed Shengzhuan's troops and seized their boats to ferry the army.
translations.idiomatic: Shengzhuan met our army with seventy thousand foot and horse; Tan Tai directed the battle; below Jiujiang he crushed Shengzhuan's force and seized their boats to cross the river.

sentences.zh: 攻南昌，為長圍困之，數月，麾將士以雲梯登，聲桓中二矢，投水死；

translations.literal: He attacked Nanchang and invested it in a long siege; after several months he ordered his officers and men to ascend on scaling ladders; Shengzhuan was struck by two arrows and drowned himself;
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Nanchang and kept it under tight siege; after several months he ordered his men up scaling ladders; Shengzhuan was hit by two arrows and threw himself into the water to die;

sentences.zh: 又破其將王得仁。

translations.literal: He also defeated Shengzhuan's general Wang Deren.
translations.idiomatic: He also defeated Shengzhuan's general Wang Deren.

sentences.zh: 南康、瑞州、臨江、袁州並下。

translations.literal: Nankang, Ruizhou, Linjiang, and Yuanzhou all fell.
translations.idiomatic: Nankang, Ruizhou, Linjiang, and Yuanzhou all submitted.

sentences.zh: 當聲桓叛時，李成棟以廣東應之，南昌圍急，成棟赴援。

translations.literal: When Shengzhuan rebelled, Li Chengdong responded from Guangdong; the siege of Nanchang was pressing and Chengdong came to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: When Shengzhuan rose, Li Chengdong answered from Guangdong; as the siege of Nanchang tightened, Chengdong marched to its relief.

sentences.zh: 譚泰師將至贛州，聞成棟入信豐，譚泰遣諸將乘勝襲擊，成棟兵潰，溺水死，克信豐。

translations.literal: Tan Tai's army was approaching Ganzhou when word came that Chengdong had entered Xinfeng; Tan Tai sent his generals to strike while momentum held; Chengdong's army collapsed and he drowned; Xinfeng was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai was nearing Ganzhou when he learned Chengdong had entered Xinfeng; he sent generals to attack in pursuit; Chengdong's force broke, he drowned, and Xinfeng was captured.

sentences.zh: 別將徇撫州、建昌。

translations.literal: Separate columns subdued Fuzhou and Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Detached columns pacified Fuzhou and Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 江西悉平。

translations.literal: Jiangxi was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 師還，授一等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was granted the rank of first-class jingqini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was granted first-class jingqini hafan.

sentences.zh: 七年，睿親王薨，上命吏、刑、工三部增設滿洲尚書各一，授譚泰吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Prince Regent Dorgon died; the emperor ordered that each of the Boards of Civil Office, Punishments, and Works add one Manchu minister, and Tan Tai was made Minister of Civil Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Prince Regent Dorgon died; the emperor added one Manchu minister each to the Boards of Civil Office, Punishments, and Works, appointing Tan Tai Minister of Civil Office.

sentences.zh: 八年，世祖親政，追論睿親王罪狀，大學士剛林、祁充格皆坐誅，罪不及譚泰。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Shizu Emperor took power in person; Dorgon's crimes were reviewed posthumously, and Grand Secretaries Ganglin and Qi Chongge were both executed, but the charges did not extend to Tan Tai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Shizu Emperor assumed personal rule; Dorgon's offenses were reviewed posthumously and Grand Secretaries Ganglin and Qi Chongge were executed, but Tan Tai was not implicated.

sentences.zh: 時圖賴已卒，索尼方罪廢，譚泰毀圖賴墓室，洩舊忿。

translations.literal: By then Tualai had died and Sony was under punishment; Tan Tai destroyed Tualai's tomb chamber, venting old resentments.
translations.idiomatic: Tualai was already dead and Sony was under sentence; Tan Tai demolished Tualai's tomb chamber to settle old scores.

sentences.zh: 五月，御史張煊劾大學士陳名夏等，下王大臣會鞫。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Censor Zhang Huang denounced Grand Secretary Chen Mingxia and others; the case was referred to a council of princes and great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Censor Zhang Huang impeached Grand Secretary Chen Mingxia and others; the case went before a council of princes and senior ministers.

sentences.zh: 譚泰袒名夏，讞上，命未下，譚泰前奏，言煊劾皆虛，且所舉諸事皆在赦前，煊以外轉嫌，誣名夏等死罪，當反坐，煊遂見法。

translations.literal: Tan Tai shielded Mingxia; when the finding was submitted the order had not yet been issued when Tan Tai came forward to memorialize that Huang's accusations were all false and that the matters he cited were all before the amnesty; Huang, turning spite outward, had falsely charged Mingxia and others with capital crimes and should himself be punished by counter-charge; Huang was then executed.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai protected Mingxia; before the verdict was promulgated he memorialized that Huang's charges were fabrications and that every item cited fell within the amnesty—Huang, venting private spite, had falsely accused Mingxia and others of capital crimes and should suffer the penalty in reverse; Huang was put to death.

sentences.zh: 譚泰愈縱恣，岳爾多其妻弟也，襲一等精奇尼哈番，為奪其族人法喀應襲一等阿思哈尼哈番合併為三等侯；

translations.literal: Tan Tai grew still more arrogant; Yue'erduo was his wife's younger brother; he had inherited first-class jingqini hafan but seized from his clansman Faka the first-class ashanihafan that Faka should have inherited, merging them into third-class marquis;
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai grew bolder still; Yue'erduo, his wife's younger brother, held first-class jingqini hafan but Tan Tai seized from his kinsman Faka the first-class ashanihafan Faka should have inherited, combining the ranks into third-class marquis;

sentences.zh: 佟圖賴其女弟之夫也，時金礪駐防杭州，妄稱員缺，以佟圖賴擬補。

translations.literal: Tong Tugai was the husband of his wife's younger sister; at the time Jin Yue was garrisoning Hangzhou and falsely declared a vacancy, proposing Tong Tugai to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Tugai was married to his wife's younger sister; Jin Yue was then garrisoning Hangzhou and falsely reported a vacancy, nominating Tong Tugai to fill it.

sentences.zh: 上自譚泰袒陳名夏構張煊，心厭惡之。

translations.literal: From the time Tan Tai shielded Chen Mingxia and framed Zhang Huang, the emperor's heart turned against him.
translations.idiomatic: Ever since Tan Tai had shielded Chen Mingxia and engineered Zhang Huang's ruin, the emperor had come to detest him.

sentences.zh: 是歲八月，下詔責其專橫，命執付獄，集廷臣議罪。

translations.literal: That year in the eighth month an edict was issued reproaching his despotism; he was ordered seized and imprisoned while the court deliberated his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of that year an edict condemned his arrogance; he was arrested and committed while ministers debated his offenses.

sentences.zh: 鰲拜复訐譚泰阿附睿親王及營私擅政諸狀，讞皆實。

translations.literal: Oboi again denounced Tan Tai for fawning on Prince Regent Dorgon and for private dealings and usurpation of authority; the findings were all upheld.
translations.idiomatic: Oboi renewed accusations that Tan Tai had curried favor with Prince Regent Dorgon and engaged in private power-grabbing; every charge was sustained.

sentences.zh: 王大臣議誅譚泰及其子孫，上命誅譚泰，籍其家，子孫貸連坐。

translations.literal: The council of princes and ministers recommended executing Tan Tai and his descendants; the emperor ordered Tan Tai executed and his property confiscated, but his descendants were spared collective punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Princes and ministers recommended death for Tan Tai and his line; the emperor ordered Tan Tai executed and his household confiscated, but spared his descendants collective punishment.

sentences.zh: =何洛會=何洛會，失其氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: He Luohui, his clan unknown, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He Luohui—the clan is not recorded—was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 父阿吉賴，事太祖，從征戰，官牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His father Ajilai served Taizu, followed campaigns, and held the office of niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ajilai served Taizu in war and held the post of niru ejen.

sentences.zh: 卒，何洛會嗣，兼巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: When Ajilai died, He Luohui succeeded him and also held the post of bayara jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: After Ajilai's death He Luohui succeeded him and also served as bayara jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，從伐明，略錦州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong he followed a campaign against Ming and raided Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tiancong he joined a campaign against the Ming and raided Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年，詔免諸功臣徭役，何洛會與焉。

translations.literal: In the ninth year an edict exempted meritorious ministers from corvée labor; He Luohui was among them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year an edict freed meritorious ministers from corvée; He Luohui was included.

sentences.zh: 崇德五年，授正黃旗蒙古固山額真。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongde he was appointed gushan ejen of the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Chongde he was made gushan ejen of the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 從睿親王多爾袞伐明，圍錦州。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Regent Dorgon in a campaign against Ming and besieged Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Regent Dorgon against the Ming and took part in the siege of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 調滿洲固山額真。

translations.literal: He was transferred to gushan ejen of the Manchu banners.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned as Manchu gushan ejen.

sentences.zh: 七年，錦州既下，追論圍錦州時何洛會匿鄂羅塞臣破陣功，當奪官，上宥之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, after Jinzhou fell, a review of the siege found that He Luohui had concealed Orosenchen's merit in breaking the enemy line; he should have been stripped of office, but the emperor pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, after Jinzhou fell, a review found He Luohui had concealed Orosenchen's breakthrough merit; dismissal was warranted, but the emperor spared him.

sentences.zh: 何洛會隸肅親王豪格，頗見任使。

translations.literal: He Luohui was attached to Prince Su Hooge and was much employed.
translations.idiomatic: He Luohui belonged to Prince Su Hooge's faction and enjoyed considerable trust.

sentences.zh: 世祖即位，睿親王攝政，與肅親王有隙。

translations.literal: When the Shizu Emperor acceded, Prince Regent Dorgon held the regency and was at odds with Prince Su.
translations.idiomatic: At the Shizu Emperor's accession Prince Regent Dorgon governed and was estranged from Prince Su.

sentences.zh: 何洛會訐肅親王與兩黃旗大臣揚善、俄莫克圖、伊成格、羅碩將謀亂，肅親王坐削爵，揚善等皆棄市。

translations.literal: He Luohui denounced Prince Su and the great ministers of the two Yellow Banners—Yangshan, Eimoketu, Yichengge, and Luoshuo—for plotting rebellion; Prince Su was stripped of his princedom and Yangshan and the others were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: He Luohui accused Prince Su and Yellow Banner ministers Yangshan, Eimoketu, Yichengge, and Luoshuo of plotting rebellion; Prince Su lost his title and Yangshan and the rest were executed.

sentences.zh: 賞何洛會告姦，籍俄莫克圖、伊成格家畀之，授世職二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: He Luohui was rewarded for exposing treachery; the households of Eimoketu and Yichengge were confiscated and given to him, and he received a hereditary rank of second-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: He Luohui was rewarded for the denunciation; Eimoketu and Yichengge's estates were confiscated for him, and he received second-class jalan janggin as a hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 尋從睿親王入關，擊李自成，逐至慶都。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he followed Prince Regent in entering the Pass and attacking Li Zicheng, pursuing him to Qingdu.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed the Prince Regent through the Pass against Li Zicheng, pursuing him to Qingdu.

sentences.zh: 還，睿親王令奉表迎世祖，擢內大臣，留守盛京。

translations.literal: On returning, the Prince Regent ordered him to present a memorial welcoming the Shizu Emperor; he was promoted to inner minister and left to guard Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: On the return the Prince Regent had him present the welcome memorial for the Shizu Emperor; he was promoted inner minister and left to guard Mukden.

sentences.zh: 阿哈尼堪將左翼，碩詹將右翼，並於熊耀城、錦州、寧遠、鳳凰城、興京、義州、新城、牛莊、岫岩城各置城守官，皆統於何洛會。

translations.literal: Ahanikan commanded the left wing and Shuozhan the right; at Xiongyao, Jinzhou, Ningyuan, Fenghuangcheng, Xingjing, Yizhou, Xincheng, Niuzhuang, and Xiuyan each had a garrison commander—all under He Luohui's command.
translations.idiomatic: Ahanikan led the left wing and Shuozhan the right; garrison commanders were placed at Xiongyao, Jinzhou, Ningyuan, Fenghuangcheng, Xingjing, Yizhou, Xincheng, Niuzhuang, and Xiuyan, all subordinate to He Luohui.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，敘功，進世職一等。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi merit was tallied and his hereditary rank was advanced to first class.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year two his service was rewarded with advancement to first-class hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 旋命率師駐防西安，道河南，討定西平土寇劉洪起等。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to lead troops garrisoning Xi'an; marching through Henan he suppressed the bandits of Dingxi and Ping and Liu Hongqi and others.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to garrison Xi'an; marching through Henan he suppressed bandits under Liu Hongqi and others in Dingxi and Ping.

sentences.zh: 是歲十二月，授定西大將軍，命自陝西徇四川。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of that year he was appointed Grand General for the Pacification of the West and ordered to advance from Shaanxi into Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: That December he was made Grand General for the Pacification of the West and ordered from Shaanxi into Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 時自成將劉體純等犯商州，叛將賀珍與其黨孫守法、胡向宸等分據漢中、興安。

translations.literal: At the time Liu Tichun and other generals of Zicheng were attacking Shangzhou; the rebel He Zhen with Sun Shoufa, Hu Xiangchen, and others held Hanzhong and Xing'an separately.
translations.idiomatic: Zicheng's generals Liu Tichun and others were raiding Shangzhou; the rebel He Zhen with Sun Shoufa, Hu Xiangchen, and others held Hanzhong and Xing'an.

sentences.zh: 三年，珍以七萬人犯西安，何洛會督兵迎戰，珍敗走，复逐破之，並破體純商州。

translations.literal: In the third year Zhen advanced on Xi'an with seventy thousand men; He Luohui met him in battle, Zhen was defeated and fled, and he was pursued and broken again; he also defeated Tichun at Shangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Zhen marched on Xi'an with seventy thousand men; He Luohui met him, drove him off, pursued and shattered him again, and also broke Tichun at Shangzhou.

sentences.zh: 肅親王從入關，破李自成，复爵。

translations.literal: Prince Su had entered the Pass and defeated Li Zicheng and his princedom was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Su, who had entered the Pass and defeated Li Zicheng, had his title restored.

sentences.zh: 至是，上命為靖遠大將軍，下四川，召何洛會還京師。

translations.literal: At this time the emperor appointed him Grand General for the Pacification of the Distance and sent him into Sichuan, recalling He Luohui to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Now the emperor made him Grand General for the Pacification of the Distance and sent him into Sichuan, recalling He Luohui to the capital.

sentences.zh: 四年，命率師駐防宣府，仍授正黃旗滿洲固山額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was ordered to lead troops garrisoning Xuanfu and was again appointed gushan ejen of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was ordered to garrison Xuanfu and again made gushan ejen of the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 五年，調鑲白旗。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 命佐譚泰定江西，擊破金聲桓、王得仁、李成棟，事具譚泰傳。

translations.literal: He was ordered to assist Tan Tai in pacifying Jiangxi, defeating Jin Shengzhuan, Wang Deren, and Li Chengdong—the details are in Tan Tai's biography.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to assist Tan Tai in pacifying Jiangxi and defeating Jin Shengzhuan, Wang Deren, and Li Chengdong, as set forth in Tan Tai's biography.

sentences.zh: 師還，賜所獲金銀珠玉，進世職三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was granted the gold, silver, and gems taken as booty and advanced to third-class jingqini hafan as a hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he received captured gold, silver, and gems and was advanced to third-class jingqini hafan.

sentences.zh: 肅親王師還，貝子屯齊等訐王諸悖妄狀，何洛會復從而證之，遂坐奪爵，以幽系終。

translations.literal: When Prince Su's army returned, Beizi Tunqi and others denounced the prince's many presumptuous acts; He Luohui again testified against him, and the prince was stripped of his title and ended his life under house arrest.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Su returned, Beizi Tunqi and others accused him of numerous transgressions; He Luohui testified again, and the prince was deposed and died under confinement.

sentences.zh: 睿親王取肅親王福金，召肅親王諸子入府校射，何洛會詈之曰：「見此鬼魅，不覺心悸！

translations.literal: Prince Regent Dorgon took Prince Su's consort Fujin; summoning the prince's sons into the mansion for archery practice, He Luohui cursed them, saying: "At the sight of these demons my heart quails!"
translations.idiomatic: Prince Regent Dorgon took Prince Su's consort Fujin and summoned the prince's sons to the mansion for archery; He Luohui cursed them: "Seeing these specters makes my heart tremble!"

sentences.zh: 」尚書譚泰聞其語。

translations.literal: " Minister Tan Tai heard his words.
translations.idiomatic: " Minister Tan Tai heard what he said.

sentences.zh: 及睿親王薨，世祖親政，何洛會語貝子錫翰曰：「兩黃旗大臣與我相惡，我嘗訐告肅親王，今豈肯容我？

translations.literal: When Prince Regent died and the Shizu Emperor took power, He Luohui said to Beizi Xihan: "The great ministers of the two Yellow Banners hate me; I once denounced Prince Su—will they now spare me?"
translations.idiomatic: After the Prince Regent's death, when the Shizu Emperor assumed rule, He Luohui told Beizi Xihan: "The two Yellow Banner ministers despise me; I once accused Prince Su—how could they tolerate me now?"

sentences.zh: 」八年二月，蘇克薩哈等訐睿親王將率兩白旗移駐永平，且私具上服禦，及薨用斂，何洛會、羅什、博爾惠等皆知狀。

translations.literal: " In the second month of the eighth year Sukesaha and others denounced the Prince Regent for planning to move the two White Banners to garrison Yongping, for privately preparing imperial robes, and for using them at his funeral; He Luohui, Luoshi, Boerhui, and others all knew of these matters.
translations.idiomatic: " In the second month of the eighth year Sukesaha and others charged that the Prince Regent had planned to move the two White Banners to Yongping, had secretly prepared imperial vestments, and had been buried in them; He Luohui, Luoshi, Boerhui, and others all knew.

sentences.zh: 時羅什、博爾惠已先誅，執何洛會，下王大臣會鞫。

translations.literal: By then Luoshi and Boerhui had already been executed; He Luohui was seized and the case referred to a council of princes and great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Luoshi and Boerhui had already been executed; He Luohui was arrested and the case sent to the council of princes and ministers.

sentences.zh: 譚泰、錫翰各以何洛會語告，又追論誣告肅親王罪，與其兄胡錫並磔死，籍其家。

translations.literal: Tan Tai and Xihan each reported He Luohui's words; his crime of falsely accusing Prince Su was reviewed again, and he and his elder brother Husu were dismembered and executed together; their households were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai and Xihan each reported He Luohui's remarks; his false accusation against Prince Su was reconsidered, and he and his elder brother Husu were torn apart and executed; their property was confiscated.

sentences.zh: =錫圖庫=錫圖庫，烏扎拉氏，滿洲正白旗人，世居烏拉。

translations.literal: Xitu Ku, of the Ujara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner; his family had long dwelt at Ula.
translations.idiomatic: Xitu Ku of the Ujara clan was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner whose family had long lived at Ula.

sentences.zh: 兄福蘭，當太祖時來歸，授世職備禦。

translations.literal: His elder brother Fulan came over in Taizu's time and received the hereditary office of beiyu.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Fulan submitted in Taizu's day and received the hereditary rank of beiyu.

sentences.zh: 卒，錫圖庫嗣，授牛錄額真，兼巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: When Fulan died, Xitu Ku succeeded him and was appointed niru ejen, also holding the post of bayara jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: After Fulan's death Xitu Ku succeeded him as niru ejen and also served as bayara jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 天聰四年，師克永平，錫圖庫與甲喇額真圖魯什等率兵循徼，得邏卒二、馬十七。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tiancong the army captured Yongping; Xitu Ku with jalan ejen Turusi and others led troops on patrol and captured two Ming scouts and seventeen horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tiancong, when Yongping was taken, Xitu Ku and jalan ejen Turusi patrolled the frontier and seized two Ming scouts and seventeen horses.

sentences.zh: 五年，诇敵大凌河，得二人以還。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he reconnoitered the enemy at Da Linghe and brought back two captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he spied on the enemy at Da Linghe and returned with two prisoners.

sentences.zh: 上伐明，圍大凌河城，敗錦州援兵，錫圖庫皆有功。

translations.literal: When the emperor campaigned against Ming and besieged Da Linghe, defeating Jinzhou relief troops, Xitu Ku had merit in all these actions.
translations.idiomatic: In the emperor's campaign against the Ming, the siege of Da Linghe, and the defeat of Jinzhou's relief force, Xitu Ku distinguished himself throughout.

sentences.zh: 六年，復從伐明，略宣府、大同邊外，多所斬獲。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he again followed a campaign against Ming, raiding beyond the borders of Xuanfu and Datong, taking many heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again joined a Ming campaign, raiding outside Xuanfu and Datong and taking many heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 八年，复略蒙古錫爾哈、錫伯圖諸地，斬七十餘級、俘百餘戶及馬駝，賚以所獲，進世職一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he again raided Mongol lands including Xierha and Xibotu, beheading more than seventy and capturing over a hundred households with horses and camels; rewarded with the booty, he was advanced to first-class jalan janggin as a hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he raided Mongol Xierha and Xibotu, took over seventy heads and more than a hundred households with livestock, received the spoils as reward, and was advanced to first-class jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 九年，偕噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦勞薩等略明邊，入長城，攻代、朔諸州，多所斬獲。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, together with Gūbushixian garai angbang Laosa and others, he raided the Ming frontier, entered the Great Wall, and attacked Dai and Shuo prefectures, taking many heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he joined Gūbushixian garai angbang Laosa and others in a raid on the Ming border, entered the Great Wall, attacked Dai and Shuo, and took many heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，睿親王多爾袞率師伐明，攻寧遠，錫圖庫以二十人前驅，至中後所及山海關外诇敵，屢得邏卒，並獲其馬，又於前屯衛設伏敗敵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde Prince Regent Dorgon led an army against Ming and attacked Ningyuan; Xitu Ku with twenty men went ahead to Zhonghou and beyond Shanhaiguan to spy on the enemy, repeatedly capturing Ming scouts and their horses, and at Qiantunwei laid an ambush and defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde year one Prince Regent Dorgon attacked the Ming at Ningyuan; Xitu Ku led twenty men ahead to Zhonghou and beyond Shanhaiguan, repeatedly seized Ming scouts and horses, and ambushed the enemy at Qiantunwei.

sentences.zh: 喀木尼堪部葉類等盜科爾沁諸部馬叛走，錫圖庫率巴牙喇壯達八人詣寧古塔，與梅勒額真吳巴海督兵追之。

translations.literal: Yelei and others of Kaminikan's division stole horses from the Khorchin tribes and fled; Xitu Ku led eight bayara daidan to Ningguta and, with meiren ejen Wubaihai, directed troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: When Yelei of Kaminikan's band stole horses from the Khorchin and fled, Xitu Ku took eight bayara daidan to Ningguta and joined meiren ejen Wubaihai in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 行數十日，及於溫鐸，招降不從，葉類潛遁，盡殲其黨九十四人，俘婦女八十餘，得馬五十六；

translations.literal: After traveling several tens of days they overtook them at Wenduo; when offers of surrender were refused Yelei slipped away secretly; his entire party of ninety-four was annihilated, over eighty women captured, and fifty-six horses taken;
translations.idiomatic: After many days they caught them at Wenduo; surrender was refused and Yelei escaped in secret; his band of ninety-four was wiped out, over eighty women taken, and fifty-six horses seized;

sentences.zh: 复逐捕葉類，入山，射之殪。

translations.literal: Again they pursued Yelei into the mountains and shot him dead.
translations.idiomatic: They pursued Yelei into the hills and shot him dead.

sentences.zh: 師還，上遣大臣出迎五里，宴勞，進世職一等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: When the army returned the emperor sent great ministers to welcome them five li out and held a feast in their honor; Xitu Ku was advanced to first-class meiren janggin as a hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return ministers met them five li out with a feast; he was advanced to first-class meiren janggin.

sentences.zh: 五年，命偕巴牙喇纛章京濟什哈率師並徵蒙古敖漢、柰曼、烏喇特諸部兵伐索倫部，敗敵於甘河，擒部長博木博郭爾，籍千餘戶，得馬數百。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered with bayara dafan janggin Jisihha to lead troops jointly recruiting Mongol forces of Aohan, Naiman, and Ulath to campaign against the Solon; they defeated the enemy on the Gan River, captured the chieftain Bomobugor, registered over a thousand households, and took several hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he and bayara dafan janggin Jisihha led a combined force of Aohan, Naiman, and Ulath Mongols against the Solon, routed them on the Gan River, seized chieftain Bomobugor, registered a thousand households, and took hundreds of horses.

sentences.zh: 師還，賜宴北驛館，進世職三等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: When the army returned a feast was given at the North Post Station; he was advanced to third-class ambad janggin as a hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: On return a feast was held at the North Post Station and he was advanced to third-class ambad janggin.

sentences.zh: 旋授本旗梅勒額真。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed meiren ejen of his own banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made meiren ejen of his banner.

sentences.zh: 七年，從貝勒阿巴泰伐明，自薊州越明都，下山東。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Beile Abatai against Ming, crossed from Jizhou over the Ming capital region, and descended into Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he followed Beile Abatai against the Ming, passed from Jizhou beyond the capital, and marched into Shandong.

sentences.zh: 師還，以先出邊，部議當奪官，命寬之，白金百。

translations.literal: When the army returned, because he had left the border first the department recommended stripping his office; the order was to be lenient and grant him one hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On the return, because he had crossed the border ahead of orders the ministry recommended dismissal; he was pardoned and given a hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 八年，擢巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was promoted to bayara dafan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was promoted to bayara dafan janggin.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從睿親王多爾袞伐明，敗李自成將唐通於一片石，遂入山海關，屢戰皆勝；

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed Prince Regent Dorgon against Ming, defeated Li Zicheng's general Tang Tong at Yipianshi, then entered Shanhaiguan and won repeated victories;
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year one he followed Prince Regent Dorgon, defeated Li Zicheng's Tang Tong at Yipianshi, entered Shanhaiguan, and won battle after battle;

sentences.zh: 敗自成遊騎於三河，追擊至安肅。

translations.literal: He defeated Zicheng's roaming cavalry at Sanhe and pursued them to Ansu.
translations.idiomatic: He routed Zicheng's scouts at Sanhe and pursued them to Ansu.

sentences.zh: 旋從固山額真葉臣等取太原，戰於汾州、於絳州，屢破敵。

translations.literal: Soon he followed gushan ejen Yechen and others in taking Taiyuan, fighting at Fenzhou and Jiangzhou and repeatedly breaking the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed gushan ejen Yechen to take Taiyuan, fought at Fenzhou and Jiangzhou, and repeatedly defeated the foe.

sentences.zh: 二年，進二等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the second year he was advanced to second-class jingqini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was advanced to second-class jingqini hafan.

sentences.zh: 時自成猶據陝西，師自潼關、綏德南北兩路入，錫圖庫率師與北路軍會，敗賊延安。

translations.literal: At that time Zicheng still held Shaanxi; the army entered by Tongguan and Suide on north and south routes; Xitu Ku led troops to join the northern wing and defeated the rebels at Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: While Zicheng still held Shaanxi the army entered by Tongguan and Suide; Xitu Ku joined the northern column and defeated the rebels at Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 自成走入湖廣，鍚圖庫移兵從之，自安陸至於荊門，屢擊敗自成兵。

translations.literal: Zicheng fled into Huguang; Xitu Ku moved his troops after him from Anlu to Jingmen and repeatedly defeated Zicheng's troops.
translations.idiomatic: Zicheng fled to Huguang; Xitu Ku followed from Anlu to Jingmen and repeatedly routed his forces.

sentences.zh: 三年，復從肅親王豪格下四川，討張獻忠。

translations.literal: In the third year he again followed Prince Su Hooge into Sichuan to suppress Zhang Xianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he again followed Prince Su Hooge into Sichuan against Zhang Xianzhong.

sentences.zh: 五年，進世職一等。

translations.literal: In the fifth year his hereditary rank was advanced to first class.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year his hereditary rank rose to first class.

sentences.zh: 復從鄭親王濟爾哈朗下湖南。

translations.literal: Again he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang into Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang into Hunan.

sentences.zh: 六年，師次長沙，錫圖庫從左翼巴牙喇纛章京努三率兵前驅，攻湘潭。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when the army reached Changsha, Xitu Ku with the left-wing bayara dafan janggin Nusan led troops ahead to attack Xiangtan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, at Changsha, Xitu Ku and left-wing bayara dafan janggin Nusan led the vanguard against Xiangtan.

sentences.zh: 努三軍北門，錫圖庫軍西門，遂克之。

translations.literal: Nusan's force took the north gate and Xitu Ku's the west gate, and the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Nusan attacked the north gate and Xitu Ku the west gate, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 進徇永興，斬明將尹舉智、杜貞明等。

translations.literal: Advancing to subdue Yongxing, he beheaded Ming generals Yin Juzhi, Du Zhenming, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Moving on to Yongxing he slew Ming generals Yin Juzhi and Du Zhenming.

sentences.zh: 再進定寶慶，取全州，破明將焦璉。

translations.literal: Advancing again he pacified Baoqing and took Quanzhou, defeating Ming general Jiao Lian.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to pacify Baoqing, took Quanzhou, and defeated Ming general Jiao Lian.

sentences.zh: 又移兵克永安關，取道州。

translations.literal: He moved his troops again, captured Yong'an Pass, and took Daozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then took Yong'an Pass and Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 師還，賜白金三百。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was granted three hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he received three hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 七年，睿親王多爾袞薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Prince Regent Dorgon died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Prince Regent Dorgon died.

sentences.zh: 八年春，吳拜、羅什、博爾輝等訐英親王阿濟格將謀亂，鞫實，錫圖庫坐與謀，誅死，籍其家。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year Wubai, Luoshi, Bo Erhui, and others denounced Prince Ying Ajige for plotting rebellion; the interrogation established the facts, and Xitu Ku was punished as a conspirator, executed, and his household confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighth year Wubai, Luoshi, and Bo Erhui accused Prince Ying Ajige of plotting rebellion; the case was proved, and Xitu Ku, implicated as a conspirator, was executed and his property confiscated.

sentences.zh: =博爾輝=博爾輝，他塔喇氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Bo Erhui, of the Tatara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Erhui of the Tatara clan was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 初以巴牙喇壯達從征棟奎部，有俘馘。

translations.literal: At first, as bayara daidan he followed a campaign against the Dongkui tribe and took captives and heads.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as bayara daidan against the Dongkui tribe and won captives and heads.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，從太宗伐明，自龍井關入攻遵化。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong he followed Taizong against Ming, entering through Longjing Pass to attack Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong year three he followed Taizong against the Ming, entering through Longjing Pass to attack Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 明總兵趙率教自山海關赴援，與戰，博爾輝斬其副將，明兵驚潰。

translations.literal: Ming Commander-in-Chief Zhao Shujiao came from Shanhaiguan to relieve the siege; in battle Bo Erhui beheaded his deputy general and the Ming army broke in panic.
translations.idiomatic: Ming commander Zhao Shujiao marched from Shanhaiguan to relieve the siege; Bo Erhui slew his deputy and the Ming force collapsed in rout.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢巴牙喇甲喇章京，兼戶部參政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to bayara jalan janggin and also made a vice minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made bayara jalan janggin and vice minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 復從伐明，與明兵遇寧遠，擊殺前隊七人。

translations.literal: Again he followed a campaign against Ming; encountering Ming troops at Ningyuan he killed seven men of their vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: He again campaigned against the Ming; at Ningyuan he struck the vanguard and killed seven men.

sentences.zh: 八年，復從伐明，攻大同，明兵三千自龍門迎戰，博爾輝與噶布什賢章京錫特庫、牛錄額真星訥等奮擊破之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he again followed a Ming campaign and attacked Datong; three thousand Ming troops came from Longmen to meet them; Bo Erhui with gūbushixian janggin Xitekui, niru ejen Sina, and others charged and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he attacked Datong; three thousand Ming troops advanced from Longmen; Bo Erhui with gūbushixian janggin Xitekui and niru ejen Sina charged and routed them.

sentences.zh: 九年，命偕承政馬福塔齎敕諭朝鮮國王。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was ordered with chengje Ma Futai to deliver an imperial edict to the Korean king.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was sent with chengje Ma Futai to present an edict to the Korean king.

sentences.zh: 師出邊招察哈爾部眾，自歸化經明邊東還，博爾輝殿。

translations.literal: When the army went beyond the border to summon Chahar tribesmen and returned east along the Ming frontier from Guihua, Bo Erhui commanded the rear guard.
translations.idiomatic: When troops crossed the border to summon the Chahar and returned east along the Ming frontier from Guihua, Bo Erhui covered the rear.

sentences.zh: 明兵二百三十追擊我師，博爾輝以二十人擊卻之，斬十人，俘一人，得馬三。

translations.literal: Two hundred thirty Ming troops pursued our army; Bo Erhui with twenty men drove them back, beheaded ten, took one captive, and seized three horses.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred thirty Ming soldiers pursued; Bo Erhui with twenty men beat them back, killed ten, took one prisoner, and seized three horses.

sentences.zh: 明兵從我師，有垂為所獲者，博爾輝救之得脫。

translations.literal: Ming troops followed our army; some were on the verge of capture when Bo Erhui rescued them and they escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Ming pursuers harried the column; men nearly taken were rescued by Bo Erhui and escaped.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，敘功，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde merit was tallied and he received the hereditary rank of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde year one his service was rewarded with hereditary niru janggin.

sentences.zh: 三年，裁參政，專任巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the third year the vice ministership was abolished and he held only bayara jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year his revenue post was removed and he served solely as bayara jalan janggin.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，兼任刑部理事官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he concurrently served as an acting official of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year one he also acted as an official of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 從入關，擊李自成，敘功，進世職二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: He followed the entry into the Pass and attacked Li Zicheng; for merit he was advanced to second-class jalan janggin as a hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the Pass against Li Zicheng and was advanced to second-class jalan janggin for his service.

sentences.zh: 旋署巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: Soon he served as acting bayara dafan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: He soon acted as bayara dafan janggin.

sentences.zh: 從順承郡王勒克德渾下湖廣，師至武昌。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Shuncheng Lekdehun into Huguang; the army reached Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Shuncheng Lekdehun into Huguang as far as Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 時自成將馬進忠、王進才既降复叛，據岳州，​​令博爾輝率師討之，次臨湘，擊敗其兵。

translations.literal: At the time Zicheng's generals Ma Jinzhong and Wang Jincai had surrendered and rebelled again, holding Yuezhou; Bo Erhui was ordered to lead troops against them, encamped at Linxiang, and defeated their army.
translations.idiomatic: Zicheng's generals Ma Jinzhong and Wang Jincai, having surrendered and rebelled again, held Yuezhou; Bo Erhui was sent against them, camped at Linxiang, and routed their force.

sentences.zh: 進攻岳州，進忠、進才走長沙，逐擊敗之，其將黑運昌以舟師降。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Yuezhou, Jinzhong and Jincai fled to Changsha; he pursued and defeated them, and their general Hei Yunchang surrendered with his river fleet.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the attack on Yuezhou, Jinzhong and Jincai fled to Changsha; he pursued and broke them, and general Hei Yunchang surrendered with his fleet.

sentences.zh: 師還，優賚。

translations.literal: When the army returned he received special rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he received exceptional rewards.

sentences.zh: 五年，真除巴牙喇纛章京，列議政大臣，進世職二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was confirmed as bayara dafan janggin, made a deliberating minister, and advanced to second-class ashanihafan as a hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was confirmed as bayara dafan janggin, seated among deliberating ministers, and advanced to second-class ashanihafan.

sentences.zh: 睿親王攝政，諸王多與忤。

translations.literal: When Prince Regent Dorgon held the regency, many princes opposed him.
translations.idiomatic: Under Prince Regent Dorgon's regency many princes fell out with him.

sentences.zh: 鄭親王濟爾哈朗降郡王，旋复爵。

translations.literal: Prince Zheng Jirhalang was reduced to commandery prince, then his princedom was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zheng Jirhalang was demoted to commandery prince, then restored.

sentences.zh: 初以端重親王博洛、敬謹親王尼堪佐理事，亦以專擅降爵。

translations.literal: At first the grave and weighty Prince Boluo and the reverent Prince Nikan assisted in government, but they too were reduced for arrogating authority.
translations.idiomatic: At first Princes Boluo and Nikan assisted in government but were also demoted for overreaching.

sentences.zh: 博爾輝及諸大臣羅什、額克親、吳拜、蘇拜皆謹事睿親王，從王獵喀喇城。

translations.literal: Bo Erhui and the great ministers Luoshi, Ekeqin, Wubai, and Subai all served the Prince Regent scrupulously and followed the prince hunting at Kala City.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Erhui and ministers Luoshi, Ekeqin, Wubai, and Subai all dutifully served the Prince Regent and joined his hunt at Kala City.

sentences.zh: 王薨，喪還。

translations.literal: When the prince died the funeral cortège returned.
translations.idiomatic: When the prince died the funeral procession returned.

sentences.zh: 英親王阿濟格為睿親王同母兄，欲繼王柄政，博爾輝等與阿爾津共發其罪，英親王奪爵幽禁，賞諸告者，博爾輝進世職二等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: Prince Ying Ajige was the Prince Regent's younger brother by the same mother and wished to succeed to his power; Bo Erhui and Arjin together exposed his crimes; Prince Ying was stripped of rank and confined; the informers were rewarded and Bo Erhui was advanced to second-class jingqini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ying Ajige, Dorgon's uterine brother, sought to seize his power; Bo Erhui and Arjin exposed his crimes; Prince Ying lost his title and was confined; informers were rewarded and Bo Erhui advanced to second-class jingqini hafan.

sentences.zh: 博爾輝等傳睿親王遺言，复理事二王親王爵，以告兩黃旗大臣。

translations.literal: Bo Erhui and others transmitted the Prince Regent's last words, restored the two princes' ranks in government, and reported this to the great ministers of the two Yellow Banners.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Erhui and others relayed the Prince Regent's dying wish, restored the two princes' titles, and informed the two Yellow Banner ministers.

sentences.zh: 居月餘，命未下，博爾輝有疾，穆爾泰往視之，博爾輝以為言。

translations.literal: After more than a month the order had not been issued; Bo Erhui fell ill; Mu'ertai went to visit him and Bo Erhui spoke of the matter.
translations.idiomatic: More than a month passed without an edict; Bo Erhui fell ill; Mu'ertai visited him and Bo Erhui raised the matter.

sentences.zh: 穆爾泰告額爾德赫，額爾德赫告敬謹郡王尼堪，遂與端重郡王博洛訴於鄭親王。

translations.literal: Mu'ertai told Eerdehe, Eerdehe told Reverent Commandery Prince Nikan, and they together with Grave Commandery Prince Boluo appealed to Prince Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Mu'ertai told Eerdehe, Eerdehe told Commandery Prince Nikan, and they with Commandery Prince Boluo appealed to Prince Zheng.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，复二王爵。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year the two princes' ranks were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year the two princes' titles were restored.

sentences.zh: 越八日，執博爾輝等下獄，坐博爾輝、羅什動搖國事，蠱惑人心，論死，籍其家。

translations.literal: Eight days later Bo Erhui and the others were seized and imprisoned; Bo Erhui and Luoshi were convicted of shaking state affairs and deluding the people; death was recommended and their households confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Eight days later Bo Erhui and the rest were arrested; Bo Erhui and Luoshi were found to have unsettled the state and misled minds; death and confiscation were recommended.

sentences.zh: 額克親削宗室籍，及吳拜、蘇拜皆奪官為民。

translations.literal: Ekeqin was struck from the imperial clan rolls; Wubai and Subai were all stripped of office and made commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Ekeqin was removed from the clan register; Wubai and Subai were demoted to commoners.

sentences.zh: 議上，得旨：「朕每聞刑人，殊不忍。

translations.literal: When the finding was submitted the imperial response said: "Whenever I hear of putting men to death I cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial reached the throne: "Whenever I hear of executions I cannot bear it.

sentences.zh: 二人罪當誅，姑宥死何如？

translations.literal: These two men's crimes merit death—might we for the present spare them?"
translations.idiomatic: These two deserve death—might we spare them for now?"

sentences.zh: 」王大臣復以初議上，乃誅死。

translations.literal: The council of princes and ministers resubmitted the original recommendation, and they were then executed.
translations.idiomatic: The council resubmitted the original verdict, and they were put to death.

sentences.zh: =冷僧機=冷僧機，納喇氏，滿洲正黃旗人，葉赫部長金台石之族也。

translations.literal: Leng Sengji, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and a kinsman of Jintai Shi, chief of the Yehe.
translations.idiomatic: Leng Sengji of the Nara clan was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and kin to Yehe chief Jintai Shi.

sentences.zh: 葉赫亡，來歸，隸正藍旗，屬貝勒莽古爾泰。

translations.literal: When Yehe perished he came over and was attached to the Plain Blue Banner under Beile Manggūltai.
translations.idiomatic: When Yehe fell he submitted and was placed under Beile Manggūltai of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年，敖漢部長索諾木來歸，尚公主為額駙，以冷僧機隸焉。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong the Aohan chief Sonomu came over, married an imperial princess as imperial son-in-law, and Leng Sengji was placed under him.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong year one Aohan chief Sonomu submitted, married an imperial princess, and Leng Sengji was assigned to him.

sentences.zh: 莽古爾泰既卒，九年，冷僧機詣法司言莽古爾泰及貝勒德格類與公主及索諾木結黨，設誓謀不軌。

translations.literal: After Manggūltai died, in the ninth year Leng Sengji went to the legal authorities to say that Manggūltai and Beile Deglei, together with the princess and Sonomu, had formed a faction, sworn oaths, and plotted sedition.
translations.idiomatic: After Manggūltai's death, in the ninth year Leng Sengji reported to the courts that Manggūltai and Beile Deglei, with the princess and Sonomu, had formed a clique, sworn bonds, and plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 冷僧機與甲喇額真屯布祿、巴克什愛巴禮並下法司，鞫實，冷僧機以自首免罪，屯布祿、​​愛巴禮皆坐誅，籍其家以★K2冷僧機，改隸正黃旗，授世職三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: Leng Sengji with jalan ejen Tunbulu and secretary Aibali were all sent to the legal authorities; the interrogation established the facts; Leng Sengji was spared for voluntary confession; Tunbulu and Aibali were both executed and their households confiscated and given to Leng Sengji; he was reassigned to the Plain Yellow Banner and granted third-class meiren janggin as a hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: Leng Sengji, jalan ejen Tunbulu, and secretary Aibali were tried; the case was proved; Leng Sengji was spared for confessing first; Tunbulu and Aibali were executed and their estates given to him; he was moved to the Plain Yellow Banner with third-class meiren janggin.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，固山額真都類坐事下兵部待鞫，兵部參政穆爾泰令諸在系者避都類。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde gushan ejen Dulei was imprisoned awaiting trial by the Board of War; Board vice minister Mu'ertai ordered all prisoners to avoid Dulei.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde year two gushan ejen Dulei was held by the Board of War; vice minister Mu'ertai ordered prisoners to shun him.

sentences.zh: 或以告冷僧機，聞於上，穆爾泰及同官皆坐降罰，授冷僧機一等侍衛。

translations.literal: Someone informed Leng Sengji, who reported it to the emperor; Mu'ertai and his colleagues were all punished with demotion, and Leng Sengji was made first-class guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: Leng Sengji heard and reported it; Mu'ertai and his colleagues were demoted and Leng Sengji was made first-class guardsman.

sentences.zh: 七年，祖大壽來歸，上幸牧馬所，命內大臣侍衛與大壽等校射，中的者有所賜，冷僧機得駝一。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Zu Dashou came over; the emperor visited the horse pastures and ordered inner ministers and guards to compete in archery with Dashou and others; those who hit the target received gifts, and Leng Sengji won a camel.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Zu Dashou submitted; at the pastures the emperor had guards compete in archery with Dashou; Leng Sengji hit the mark and received a camel.

sentences.zh: 世祖即位，授內大臣。

translations.literal: When the Shizu Emperor acceded he was appointed inner minister.
translations.idiomatic: At the Shizu Emperor's accession he was made inner minister.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，進二等阿思哈尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi he was advanced to second-class ashanihafan with tošalaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi year two he was advanced to second-class ashanihafan with tošalaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 譚泰訐索尼，引冷僧機為證，謝未聞，坐徇庇，當削世職籍沒，上貰之。

translations.literal: When Tan Tai denounced Sony he cited Leng Sengji as witness; Leng Sengji denied hearing of it and was punished for favoritism—his hereditary rank and register should have been confiscated, but the emperor pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: When Tan Tai accused Sony he called Leng Sengji as witness; Leng Sengji denied knowledge and was sentenced for shielding Sony; confiscation was ordered but the emperor spared him.

sentences.zh: 旋進世職三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: Soon he was advanced to third-class jingqini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon advanced to third-class jingqini hafan.

sentences.zh: 七年，睿親王有疾，怨上未臨視，冷僧機及貝子錫翰等奏請上臨視，睿親王坐以擅請降世職，恩詔復故，進一等伯。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, when the Prince Regent was ill and resented that the emperor had not visited him, Leng Sengji and Beizi Xihan memorialized asking the emperor to visit; the Prince Regent was punished for presumptuous request and reduced in hereditary rank, then restored by grace and advanced to first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the Prince Regent, ill and resenting the emperor's failure to visit, was memorialized by Leng Sengji and Beizi Xihan; the regent punished the request as presumptuous and was reduced, then pardoned and advanced to first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 睿親王薨，以豫親王多鐸子多爾博為後，襲爵。

translations.literal: When the Prince Regent died, Prince Yu Dodo's son Du'erbo was made his heir and inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: At the Prince Regent's death Prince Yu Dodo's son Du'erbo was adopted as heir and inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 冷僧機言於上曰：「昔太宗登遐，兩黃旗大臣誓立肅親王。

translations.literal: Leng Sengji said to the emperor: "When Taizong passed away, the great ministers of the two Yellow Banners swore to establish Prince Su.
translations.idiomatic: Leng Sengji told the emperor: "When Taizong died the two Yellow Banner ministers swore to make Prince Su heir.

sentences.zh: 睿親王定策奉上紹統，多爾博宜特見優遇。

translations.literal: The Prince Regent settled the decision to have Your Majesty succeed the throne; Du'erbo ought to receive special favor."
translations.idiomatic: The Prince Regent settled the succession for Your Majesty; Du'erbo deserves exceptional favor."

sentences.zh: 」又舉侍衛羅什，羅什上為冷僧機乞恩。

translations.literal: He also recommended guardsman Luoshi, and Luoshi memorialized the throne to beg grace for Leng Sengji.
translations.idiomatic: He also commended guardsman Luoshi, who memorialized favor for Leng Sengji.

sentences.zh: 八年，鄭親王濟爾哈朗等劾羅什蠱惑諸王，坐誅，辭連冷僧機。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Prince Zheng Jirhalang and others impeached Luoshi for deluding the princes; he was executed and the case implicated Leng Sengji.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Prince Zheng and others impeached Luoshi for misleading the princes; Luoshi was executed and Leng Sengji was implicated.

sentences.zh: 上因命諸大臣詰誓立肅親王事，冷僧機窮，諸大臣兼發阿諛睿親王諸罪，論斬籍沒，命寬之。

translations.literal: The emperor therefore ordered the great ministers to examine the oath to establish Prince Su; Leng Sengji was cornered, and the ministers also raised his crimes of fawning on the Prince Regent; death and confiscation were recommended but the emperor was lenient.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered ministers to investigate the Prince Su oath; Leng Sengji was trapped, and ministers added his flattery of the Prince Regent; death was recommended but mercy granted.

sentences.zh: 九年，追論冷僧機與貝子鞏阿岱、錫翰，內大臣西訥布庫等迎合睿親王，亂國政，下王大臣鞫實，與鞏阿岱、錫翰、西訥布庫等並誅，籍其家。

translations.literal: In the ninth year a review condemned Leng Sengji with Beizi Gongadai, Xihan, inner minister Sinaibuku, and others for currying favor with the Prince Regent and disturbing government; the interrogation established the facts and he was executed with Gongadai, Xihan, Sinaibuku, and the rest; their households were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Leng Sengji, Beizi Gongadai, Xihan, inner minister Sinaibuku, and others were reviewed for fawning on the Prince Regent and disordering government; proved guilty, they were executed and their property confiscated.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：定金聲桓、王得仁之亂，譚泰專將，何洛會為之佐。

translations.literal: The commentary says: In settling the disorders of Jin Shengzhuan and Wang Deren, Tan Tai was the sole commander and He Luohui his assistant.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: In quelling Jin Shengzhuan and Wang Deren, Tan Tai commanded alone and He Luohui assisted.

sentences.zh: 錫圖庫、博爾輝亦久從征戰有勞。

translations.literal: Xitu Ku and Bo Erhui also long followed campaigns with merit.
translations.idiomatic: Xitu Ku and Bo Erhui likewise served long in war with distinction.

sentences.zh: 睿親王既薨，諸阿附者乃互相傾，何洛會之獄，譚泰證之；

translations.literal: After the Prince Regent died, those who had fawned on him turned on one another; in He Luohui's case Tan Tai testified;
translations.idiomatic: After the Prince Regent's death his adherents turned on each other; Tan Tai testified in He Luohui's trial;

sentences.zh: 錫圖庫之誅，博爾輝等發之：轉相排軋，同就誅夷。

translations.literal: Xitu Ku's execution was exposed by Bo Erhui and others: each denouncing the other, they alike met execution.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Erhui and others exposed Xitu Ku—mutual denunciation ending in common ruin.

sentences.zh: 若冷僧機者，專事告訐，其及也亦宜矣。

translations.literal: As for Leng Sengji, who devoted himself to informing and denunciation, it was fitting that ruin should reach him too.
translations.idiomatic: Men like Leng Sengji, who lived by accusation, were justly destroyed in their turn.
